**Expanding Download Functionality**

I'm currently focused on the download functionality. Instead of bundling all periods into a single file, I'm now exploring how to generate and offer individual `.docx` downloads for each period created by the lesson plan generator. This will increase usability and flexibility by enabling users to manage and access each period's plan separately. I'm exploring different libraries and APIs to streamline the process.


**Refining Download Buttons**

I'm now prioritizing the download button placement and functionality.  Instead of just one download, I'm integrating individual "Download this period" buttons directly next to each lesson plan preview.  This directly addresses the user's need for separate downloads, enhancing the granular control.  I'll likely retain a "Download All" option, but the focus is on per-period downloads.


**Implementing Per-Period Downloads**

I've refactored the `exportToDocx` function to accept either a single lesson plan or an array, allowing for granular downloads. The filename generation now includes the period number for clarity. I'm updating `App.tsx` and the display components to support this new single-plan download functionality, adding individual download buttons alongside each period's preview, and removing the global download button.


**Adjusting Download Filenames**

I've been working on the download filenames to make them more descriptive. The new filename format will be `GiaoAn_Mon_Bai_Tiet_X.docx`, which translates to `LessonPlan_Subject_Topic_Period_X.docx` in English. I've updated the translation files (`i18n/translations.ts`) with new strings for the download buttons, ensuring they are clear in both Vietnamese and English. I'm also ensuring the `exportToDocx` function can handle downloads for a single lesson plan. Now, it needs to generate a file for just one `LessonPlan` object.


**Reorganizing Display & Buttons**

I'm now revising the download button placement within the lesson plan display. Instead of generating buttons from a top-level component, the goal is to integrate them directly beside the relevant lesson sections for improved user experience. I'm focusing on cleaning up the button layout within `LessonPlanDisplay.tsx` to handle a list of sections, and to ensure each section has its associated download button. This aims to better match the user's expectation of the download location.


**Updating Docx Generation**

I'm now revising the `exportToDocx` function to improve the filename generation. I'm introducing an optional `periodIndex` parameter to handle single-period downloads properly. The filename will now include the period number when it's a specific period download, making it easier to identify individual files. The core logic now examines the array length, using the length as a signal for the download type.

export const generateLessonPlan = async (data: LessonPlanInput, files: FileWithPreview[], locale: 'vi' | 'en', apiKey: string): Promise<LessonPlan[]> => {
  const ai = new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey });

  const isCv5512 = data.template === 'cv5512';
  const prompt = isCv5512 ? getPrompt5512(data, files, locale) : getPrompt1001(data, files, locale);
  const schema = isCv5512 ? lessonPlan5512Schema : lessonPlan1001Schema;

  const imageParts = await Promise.all(
    files.filter(file => file.type.startsWith('image/')).map(fileToGenerativePart)
  );

  try {
    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({
      model: 'gemini-2.5-flash',
      contents: { parts: [{ text: prompt }, ...imageParts] },
      config: {
        responseMimeType: 'application/json',
        responseSchema: schema,
      }
    });

    const jsonText = response.text.trim();
    const result = JSON.parse(jsonText);
    
    // The model might return a single object instead of an array if periods=1
    const resultArray = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [result];

    const finalResult = resultArray.map((plan: any) => {
      // Defensively parse the 'periods' field to ensure it's a number,
      // as the model might occasionally return a string like "(3)" or "3 tiết".
      const rawPeriods = plan.periods ?? 1;
      const parsedPeriods = parseInt(String(rawPeriods).replace(/\D/g, ''), 10);
      
      return {
        ...plan,
        template: data.template,
        periods: isNaN(parsedPeriods) ? 1 : parsedPeriods,
      };
    });

    return finalResult as LessonPlan[];
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Gemini API call failed:", error);

    if (error instanceof Error && (error.message.includes('API key not valid') || error.message.includes('API_KEY_INVALID'))) {
        throw new Error('API_KEY_INVALID');
    }

    if (error instanceof Error && (error.message.includes('RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED') || error.message.includes('429'))) {
        const quotaErrorMessage = locale === 'en' 
            ? `You have exceeded your API quota. Please check your plan and billing details.\nTo monitor your current usage, head to: https://ai.dev/usage?tab=rate-limit\nFor more information on this error, head to: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits`
            : `Bạn đã vượt quá hạn ngạch API. Vui lòng kiểm tra gói cước và chi tiết thanh toán.\nĐể theo dõi mức sử dụng của bạn, hãy truy cập: https://ai.dev/usage?tab=rate-limit\nĐể biết thêm thông tin về lỗi này, hãy truy cập: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits`;
        throw new Error(quotaErrorMessage);
    }

    if (error instanceof Error && (error.message.includes('500') || error.message.includes('UNKNOWN') || error.message.includes('Rpc failed'))) {
        const serverErrorMessage = locale === 'en'
         ? "The AI service encountered a temporary internal error (Code: 500). Please wait a moment and try again. If the problem persists, the service may be temporarily unavailable."

        throw new Error(serverErrorMessage);
    }

    const errorMessage = locale === 'en'

        : "Không thể tạo giáo án từ AI. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại thông tin và thử lại.";
    throw new Error(errorMessage);
  }
};

export const generateLessonPlan = async (data: LessonPlanInput, files: FileWithPreview[], locale: 'vi' | 'en', apiKey: string): Promise<LessonPlan[]> => {
  const ai = new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey });

  const isCv5512 = data.template === 'cv5512';
  const prompt = isCv5512 ? getPrompt5512(data, files, locale) : getPrompt1001(data, files, locale);
  const schema = isCv5512 ? lessonPlan5512Schema : lessonPlan1001Schema;

  const imageParts = await Promise.all(
    files.filter(file => file.type.startsWith('image/')).map(fileToGenerativePart)
  );

  try {
    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({
      model: 'gemini-2.5-flash',
      contents: { parts: [{ text: prompt }, ...imageParts] },
      config: {
        responseMimeType: 'application/json',
        responseSchema: schema,
      }
    });

    const jsonText = response.text.trim();
    const result = JSON.parse(jsonText);
    
    // The model might return a single object instead of an array if periods=1
    const resultArray = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [result];

    const finalResult = resultArray.map((plan: any) => {
      // Defensively parse the 'periods' field to ensure it's a number,
      // as the model might occasionally return a string like "(3)" or "3 tiết".
      const rawPeriods = plan.periods ?? 1;
      const parsedPeriods = parseInt(String(rawPeriods).replace(/\D/g, ''), 10);
      
      return {
        ...plan,
        template: data.template,
        periods: isNaN(parsedPeriods) ? 1 : parsedPeriods,
      };
    });

    return finalResult as LessonPlan[];
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Gemini API call failed:", error);

    if (error instanceof Error && (error.message.includes('API key not valid') || error.message.includes('API_KEY_INVALID'))) {
        throw new Error('API_KEY_INVALID');
    }

    if (error instanceof Error && (error.message.includes('RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED') || error.message.includes('429'))) {
        const quotaErrorMessage = locale === 'en' 
            ? `You have exceeded your API quota. Please check your plan and billing details.\nTo monitor your current usage, head to: https://ai.dev/usage?tab=rate-limit\nFor more information on this error, head to: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits`
            : `Bạn đã vượt quá hạn ngạch API. Vui lòng kiểm tra gói cước và chi tiết thanh toán.\nĐể theo dõi mức sử dụng của bạn, hãy truy cập: https://ai.dev/usage?tab=rate-limit\nĐể biết thêm thông tin về lỗi này, hãy truy cập: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits`;
        throw new Error(quotaErrorMessage);

        const serverErrorMessage = locale === 'en'
         ? "The AI service encountered a temporary internal error (Code: 500). Please wait a moment and try again. If the problem persists, the service may be temporarily unavailable."

  }
};
